PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Business data analyst with five years turning warehouse data into weekly
decisions for retail and logistics teams. Writes structured queries with
window functions and CTEs, automates reporting in a leading data
scripting language using its dataframe library, and builds executive
dashboards in a drag-and-drop BI platform. Communicates findings in
plain language that operations teams act on.

SKILLS
- Querying: warehouse structured queries — window functions, CTEs,
  query plans and index-aware tuning
- Scripting: a leading open-source data scripting language; dataframe
  wrangling, notebook workflows, scheduled report automation
- BI: drag-and-drop dashboard platform — extracts, calculated fields,
  row-level security, executive scorecards
- Modelling: spreadsheet business models with scenario toggles and
  sensitivity views for finance reviews
- Communication: written insight memos, stakeholder walkthroughs
